conversation.contentPreview:
Create a complete single self-contained file `chip8_openai-gpt-5.6-terra_01.html` (HTML + CSS + JavaScript inline;
no external libraries, CDNs, assets or backend). Build a working CHIP-8 emulator.

Implement the interpreter properly: 4 KB of memory with the font set loaded at 0x050 and programs at 0x200,
sixteen 8-bit registers V0 to VF, the 16-bit index register, the program counter, a call stack, and the
delay and sound timers counting down at 60 Hz. Decode and execute the complete instruction set of 35
instructions, including the arithmetic and logic group with the carry and borrow flags in VF, the shift
instructions, jumps and calls, the random instruction, BCD conversion, register save and load, and the key
tests.

The display is 64 by 32 pixels drawn on a canvas scaled to a readable size, with sprites drawn by XOR and
the collision flag set in VF. The 16-key keypad is mapped to a 4 by 4 block of keyboard keys shown in the
interface; key press and release must both reach the emulator.

Include a small demo ROM as a byte array inside the file: a real program, assembled by you, that draws a
sprite and moves or reacts to a key, so that the emulator can be tried without any download. Also allow
loading a ROM from a local file.

Add run, pause, single step and reset controls, an adjustable instructions-per-frame speed, and a debugger
panel showing the registers, the index register, the program counter, the stack and the decoded current
instruction. Every visible control must work. Deliver the one file `chip8_openai-gpt-5.6-terra_01.html`.

{"path":"chip8_openai-gpt-5.6-terra_01.html","edit_description":"Create this new single self-contained HTML file implementing a polished, usable CHIP-8 emulator (all CSS and JavaScript inline; no external dependencies). Build an accessible dark dashboard UI with: header/title and status badge; a 64x32 canvas at 10x scale; Run, Pause, Single step, Reset, and Load ROM controls (file input hidden and connected to Load ROM); adjustable instructions-per-frame range input with a live numeric label; clear 4x4 CHIP-8 keypad shown in interface using keyboard mappings 1 2 3 4 / Q W E R / A S D F / Z X C V mapped respectively to CHIP-8 1 2 3 C / 4 5 6 D / 7 8 9 E / A 0 B F. Key press and release must set the emulator keypad state, visibly update keypad keys, prevent default for mapped physical keys, and not cause repeated virtual button effects. Include concise instructions and an info panel. Add a debugger with all V0–VF register values, I, PC, DT, ST, stack, and decoded current opcode/instruction, updating while running and stepping.

Implement a robust CHIP-8 class with: memory Uint8Array(4096), V Uint8Array(16), I, pc initialized at 0x200, stack array, delayTimer, soundTimer, keys Uint8Array(16), display Uint8Array(64*32), paused/running status, and an active ROM. Load the standard 80-byte CHIP-8 font set at 0x050 on reset. ROM program starts at 0x200. Support ROM loading through FileReader and safely reject oversized ROMs. The reset control should reset/reload the currently active ROM and pause. A supplied DEMO_ROM byte array must be a real assembled program that clears screen, draws a custom 5-byte sprite from its embedded data and moves it left/right/up/down using key tests (with wrapping/clamping behavior), continuously looping; it should work immediately without a download. Start the demo paused, but draw its initial state by stepping enough/reset initialization such that canvas isn’t blank (or initialize display); show 'Built-in movement demo' state.

Interpreter: safely fetch 16-bit opcodes (halt/pause on invalid PC), preincrement PC; implement complete standard classic CHIP-8 instruction set including 0NNN ignored, 00E0 CLS, 00EE RET, 1NNN JP, 2NNN CALL, 3XKK, 4XKK, 5XY0, 6XKK, 7XKK, 8XY0/1/2/3/4 (VF carry)/5 (VF !borrow)/6 (use Vx source, VF LSB)/7 (VF !borrow)/E (VF MSB)/8XYE (use Vx source, VF MSB), 9XY0, ANNN, BNNN (classic V0 offset), CXKK, DXYN (XOR graphics wrapping at screen edges, VF collision), EX9E and EXA1 key skips, FX07, FX0A (must stall correctly until a fresh keydown arrives; no key-repeat), FX15, FX18, FX1E, FX29 (font address), FX33 BCD, FX55 and FX65 (do not modify I; classic modern behavior). This equals the standard 35-opcode family behavior requested. DecodeCurrent() must return understandable mnemonic strings for every implemented opcode and an UNKNOWN fallback. Catch execution errors in the frame loop and show an error status instead of crashing.

Rendering: canvas dimensions 640x320 with logical framebuffer at 64x32, pixelated style and colours that contrast. requestAnimationFrame loop executes configured instructions-per-frame only when running, then renders and refreshes debugger; independent timer accumulator decrements timers exactly at 60Hz (potentially multiple ticks if frame delay) regardless of execution state. Optional short audible beep triggered only while ST changes/is nonzero using Web Audio lazily, but do not make it intrusive; sound functionality must not break if blocked. Ensure each visible UI control is hooked up and functions. Use clean commented vanilla JS."}
